haskins-magdalen: Susan Haskins, Mary Magdalen: Myth and Metaphor (1993)
deissmann-light: Adolf Deissmann, Light from the Ancient East: The New Testament Illustrated by Recently Discovered Texts of the Graeco-Roman World, trans. Lionel R. M. Strachan, revised ed. (1927)
julia-severa-inscription: The Julia Severa inscription (Acmonia in Phrygia, later first century AD), Corpus Inscriptionum Iudaicarum 766, honoring the Gentile benefactor who built the synagogue
witherington-women-ministry: Ben Witherington III, Women in the Ministry of Jesus, SNTS Monograph Series 51 (1984)
reid-better-part: Barbara E. Reid, Choosing the Better Part? Women in the Gospel of Luke (1996)
cdf-libertatis-nuntius: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith, Libertatis Nuntius, Instruction on Certain Aspects of the "Theology of Liberation" (1984)
chrysostom-wealth-poverty: John Chrysostom, On Wealth and Poverty (sermons on the rich man and Lazarus, Antioch, about AD 388), trans. Catharine P. Roth (1984)
urban-consuluit: Pope Urban III, decretal Consuluit (about 1186–1187), in the Decretals of Gregory IX, book 5, title 19, on usury
vix-pervenit: Benedict XIV, encyclical Vix Pervenit, on usury and other dishonest profit (1745)
nicaea-canon17: Council of Nicaea (AD 325), canon 17, forbidding clergy to lend at interest
kassiani-hymn: Kassia (Kassiani), troparion "Lord, the woman who had fallen into many sins" (Constantinople, 800s), sung at Matins of Holy Wednesday in the Orthodox Church
